name: Guyun Stone Forest
description: It is an archipelago of seven large islands and smaller offshoots. The northernmost island houses the Geo Hypostasis, and the island to the southwest holds the Domain of Guyun. According to legend, this is where Rex Lapis defeated a god and sea monster known as Osial, and the jagged cliffs protruding from the islands at Guyun are in fact the remnants of the stone lances he used in that battle. It seems that those who spend the night at Guyun Stone Forest may experience Osial's memories of its defeat; whether this is caused by Osial's power or another phenomenon is unknown.
